options.name: cachedir
options.description: An alternative package cache directory, passed as C(--cachedir) to all pacman commands. Only used when O(root) is also specified.

options.name: config
options.description: Path to an alternative pacman configuration file, passed as C(--config) to all pacman commands.

options.name: executable
options.description: Path of the binary to use. This can either be C(pacman) or a pacman compatible AUR helper. Pacman compatibility is unfortunately ill defined, in particular, this modules makes extensive use of the C(--print-format) directive which is known not to be implemented by some AUR helpers (notably, C(yay)). Beware that AUR helpers might behave unexpectedly and are therefore not recommended.

options.name: extra_args
options.description: Additional option to pass to pacman when enforcing O(state).

options.name: force
options.description: When removing packages, forcefully remove them, without any checks. Same as O(extra_args="--nodeps --nodeps"). When combined with O(update_cache), force a refresh of all package databases. Same as O(update_cache_extra_args="--refresh --refresh").

options.name: name
options.description: Name or list of names of the package(s) or file(s) to install, upgrade, or remove. Cannot be used in combination with O(upgrade).

options.name: reason
options.description: The install reason to set for the packages.

options.name: reason_for
options.description: Set the install reason for V(all) packages or only for V(new) packages. In case of O(state=latest) already installed packages which are updated to a newer version are not counted as V(new).

options.name: remove_nosave
options.description: When removing packages, do not save modified configuration files as C(.pacsave) files. (passes C(--nosave) to pacman).

options.name: root
options.description: An alternative installation root directory, passed as C(--root) to all pacman commands. Useful for installing packages into a chroot or a new system root, similarly to how C(pacstrap) works.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to install (V(present) or V(installed), V(latest)), or remove (V(absent) or V(removed)) a package. V(present) and V(installed) simply ensure that a desired package is installed. V(latest) updates the specified package if it is not of the latest available version. V(absent) and V(removed) remove the specified package.

options.name: update_cache
options.description: Whether or not to refresh the master package lists. This can be run as part of a package installation or as a separate step. If not specified, it defaults to V(false). Please note that this option only had an influence on the module's RV(ignore:changed) state if O(name) and O(upgrade) are not specified before community.general 5.0.0. See the examples for how to keep the old behavior.

options.name: update_cache_extra_args
options.description: Additional option to pass to pacman when enforcing O(update_cache).

options.name: upgrade
options.description: Whether or not to upgrade the whole system. Cannot be used in combination with O(name). If not specified, it defaults to V(false).

options.name: upgrade_extra_args
options.description: Additional option to pass to pacman when enforcing O(upgrade).
